The '''2026 Islington London Borough Council election''' took place on 7 May 2026.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2026-01-01 |title=Local elections in London will test support for Reform UK and Greens |url=https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c99k0mzj7x8o |access-date=2026-01-19 |website=[[BBC News]] |language=en-GB}}</ref> All 51 members of [[Islington London Borough Council]] will be elected. The elections will take place alongside [[2026 London local elections|local elections in the other London boroughs]] and [[2026 United Kingdom local elections|elections to local authorities across the United Kingdom]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=Number of councils that have requested delay to local elections revealed - is yours one of them? |url=https://news.sky.com/story/local-elections-2026-over-a-third-of-councils-offered-a-delay-have-requested-one-is-yours-on-the-list-13494762 |access-date=2026-01-19 |website=Sky News |language=en}}</ref>

== Background ==
Labour held control of the council in [[2022 Islington London Borough Council election|2022]]. In 2026, councillor [[Sara Hyde, Baroness Hyde of Bemerton|Sara Hyde]] was appointed to the [[House of Lords]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=Political Peerages December 2025 |url=https://www.gov.uk/government/news/political-peerages-december-2025 |access-date=2025-12-10 |website=GOV.UK |language=en}}</ref>

Changes 2022–2026:
*March 2023: Matt Nathan (Labour) leaves party to sit as an independent<ref>{{cite news |last1=Rowley |first1=Izzy |title=‘Protest’ councillor quits Labour |url=https://www.islingtontribune.co.uk/article/protest-councillor-quits-labour |access-date=20 January 2026 |work=Islington Tribune |date=24 March 2023 |language=en-gb}}</ref>
*November 2023: Asima Shaikh (Labour) leaves party to sit as an independent<ref>{{cite news |last1=Gregory |first1=Julia |title=Islington councillor quits Labour over party leadership's stance on Gaza ceasefire |url=https://www.islingtoncitizen.co.uk/2023/11/15/islington-councillor-quits-labour-party-leadership-gaza-ceasefire/ |access-date=20 January 2026 |work=Islington Citizen |date=15 November 2023}}</ref>
*March 2024: Dave Poyser (Labour) resigns – by-election held May 2024<ref>{{cite news |last1=Maskell |first1=Caitlin |title=Beloved Hillrise councillor steps down after 10 years |url=https://islingtonnow.co.uk/beloved-islington-councillor-steps-down-after-10-years/ |access-date=20 January 2026 |work=Islington Now |date=20 March 2024}}</ref>
*May 2024:
**Ollie Steadman (Labour) wins by-election<ref name="Hillrise">{{cite web |title=Local Elections Archive Project — Hillrise Ward |url=https://www.andrewteale.me.uk/leap/ward/21615/#2024-05-02 |website=www.andrewteale.me.uk |access-date=20 January 2026}}</ref>
**Philip Graham (Labour) suspended from party<ref>{{cite news |last1=Rodgers |first1=Sienna |title=Islington Labour Councillor Suspended After Backing Jeremy Corbyn |url=https://www.politicshome.com/news/article/islington-labour-councillor-suspended-backing-jeremy-corbyn |access-date=20 January 2026 |work=Politics Home |date=24 May 2024 |language=en}}</ref>
*July 2024:
**Ollie Steadman (Labour) resigns – by-election held August 2024<ref>{{cite news |last1=Loubser |first1=Isabel |title=Gone in 69 days! |url=https://www.islingtontribune.co.uk/article/gone-in%E2%80%8869-days |access-date=20 January 2026 |work=Islington Tribune |date=12 July 2024 |language=en-gb}}</ref>
**Ilkay Cinko-Oner (Labour) leaves party to sit as an independent<ref>{{cite news |last1=Loubser |first1=Isabel |title=Third councillor quits Labour for seat in independent corner |url=https://www.islingtontribune.co.uk/article/third-councillor-quits-labour-for-seat-in-independent-corner |access-date=20 January 2026 |work=Islington Tribune |date=12 July 2024 |language=en-gb}}</ref>
*August 2024: Shreya Nanda (Labour) wins by-election<ref name="Hillrise" />
*October 2024: [[Kaya Comer-Schwartz]] (Labour) resigns – by-election held November 2024<ref>{{cite news |last1=Loubser |first1=Isabel |title=Islington Council leader resigns |url=https://www.islingtontribune.co.uk/article/islington-council-leader-resigns |access-date=20 January 2026 |work=Islington Tribune |date=11 October 2024 |language=en-gb}}</ref>
*November 2024: James Potts (Labour) wins by-election<ref>{{cite web |title=Local Elections Archive Project — Junction Ward |url=https://www.andrewteale.me.uk/leap/ward/21617/#2024-11-28 |website=www.andrewteale.me.uk |access-date=20 January 2026}}</ref>
